description: This source file defines a singleton enum GatewayLaunchAgentManager that manages macOS launch agents for a gateway service, including checking status, enabling/disabling the launch agent, restarting, and configuration snapshot retrieval. It handles file operations, command executions, and JSON parsing related to launch agent management.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks whether the launch agent write operations are disabled by verifying the presence of a marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file to disable or enable launch agent write operations.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the launch agent daemon is loaded by parsing daemon status JSON.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent by running appropriate commands, considering remote mode and disable marker.

methods.name: kickstart
methods.description: Restarts the daemon by invoking a restart command.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current launch agent configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the log path for the gateway by inspecting the launch agent configuration.

methods.name: readDaemonLoaded
methods.description: Private method to parse JSON output from a command to determine if the daemon is loaded.

methods.name: runDaemonCommand
methods.description: Runs a daemon command and returns nil or error message based on success.

methods.name: runDaemonCommandResult
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, parses JSON output, and returns a structured result indicating success and payload.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures command line args include '--json' for JSON output.

methods.name: parseDaemonJson
methods.description: Extracts JSON object from raw command output.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns the last line summary of given text for logging purposes.
